I'm sorry. You wrote to us and nobody came back to you, and that's on us, not you.

Straight answer: the Fluminer L3 line is $4,085, it has never shipped, and we have no stock and no date for it. There's nothing in our range close enough to it to offer you as a swap in good faith, so the money back is the right ask. A refund that size has to be issued by Abel or Georges, and I've put it in front of them with the full history.

They're offline now, pick it up at 10am ET tomorrow, and you'll get the confirmation at (email hidden) No restocking fee on this, it never shipped.

Thanks for being patient with this one. It's with Abel and Georges now, and they'll come back to you at 10am ET tomorrow by email, with a copy of this chat too.

One thing that would help them: did you send those emails to us from this same address, (email hidden), or a different one? Our support mailbox had a fault a few weeks back and I want to make sure nothing else of yours is sitting unanswered.

Completely fair. A year waiting, money paid, emails ignored, and the unit never came. I'd be furious too.

The refund request is in front of Abel and Georges with the dates and the line amount, so they don't need you to explain it again. They pick it up at 10am ET tomorrow and write to (email hidden)

If you'd rather they call you instead of email, give me a number and I'll put it on the case.

They start at 10am ET tomorrow. If you'd rather hear from them at a particular time of day, tell me and I'll add that too.
